newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon construction activity down in October.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon construction activity down in October.

text.p: Construction activity continued a slowing trend in October, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin on Friday.
Cement deliveries dropped to 368,000 tonnes from 376,000 tonnes in September and 391,639 tonnes in August.
"Cement deliveries reached 368,000 tonnes during this month, thus registering a monthly and yearly decline of 2.0 percent and 10.9 percent respectively," the Bank said.
Total area of construction permits also declined by 57.7 percent from the same period in 1995, the Bank said.
"Total area of new construction permits granted by the Association of Engineering in Beirut and Tripoli was 1,008,438 square meters".
